coverage: native/web, default/release dictionary projections and set operations
removed entries, appended/reinserted entries and insertion order
independent nested keys/values and retained dictionary snapshots
live zero/none payloads and empty dictionaries

limits: Map construction/removal is outside the timed kernel.
The map retains 25% tombstones; its values are two-element integer arrays.
This measures repeated projections, not overall application performance.
